salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 40,000 per month (consolidated) for Master's degree holders and Rs. 45,000 per month for Doctoral degree holders; part-time Rs. 2,000 per contact hour up to Rs. 40,000 per month

how_to_apply: Fill the details in the application proforma given with the notice, typed, in two copies.
Attend the walk-in interview on 18.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of the Dean (Forestry), College of Forestry, Sirsi.
Bring all original documents related to qualification and two sets of self-attested copies.
Do not send the application in advance.
important_instructions: Applications must not be sent in advance If eligible reserved-category candidates are unavailable, eligible candidates of other categories will be considered Notice is subject to final orders of the High Court, Bengaluru in Writ Petition Nos. 28612/2025 and 23399/2026 and Government orders

rows.university_of_agricultural_sciences_dhar: Rs. 40,000 per month (consolidated) for Master's degree holders and Rs. 45,000 per month for Doctoral degree holders; part-time Rs. 2,000 per contact hour up to Rs. 40,000 per month

Master's degree in Agril. Statistics with at least 55% (traditional) / 60% (trimester) / 70% (semester) marks or equivalent grade, plus NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D as per UGC Guidelines 2009/2016. Master's degree holders may be considered if no NET/Ph.D candidates are available.

content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 550/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UAS Dharwad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% (traditional system) or 60% (trimester system) or 70% (semester system) marks, or an equivalent grade, in Agril. Statistics from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University; Relaxation of 5% at Master's level for candidates specified in No.2.4 of guidelines No.R/R1G/R006/2022-23 dated 15.03.2023; Cleared NET conducted by UGC/ICAR/CSIR or a similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET, or awarded a Ph.D as per UGC Guidelines 2009 or 2016 (exempted from NET/SLET/SET); If no candidates with NET or Ph.D are available on the walk-in date, candidates with a Master's degree will be considered Other conditions: Candidates must attend the interview without any cost to the University. In case of non-availability of reserved category candidates, others will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment for a period not exceeding 179 days University may relieve the appointee from duty at any time Temporary appointment gives no claim to direct appointment in the University

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection by walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Typed application in the prescribed proforma, two copies, with photographs All original documents related to qualification Two sets of self-attested copies of the documents Caste certificate Experience certificates NCC/NSS certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the details in the application proforma given with the notice, typed, in two copies. Attend the walk-in interview on 18.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of the Dean (Forestry), College of Forestry, Sirsi. Bring all original documents related to qualification and two sets of self-attested copies. Do not send the application in advance.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications must not be sent in advance If eligible reserved-category candidates are unavailable, eligible candidates of other categories will be considered Notice is subject to final orders of the High Court, Bengaluru in Writ Petition Nos. 28612/2025 and 23399/2026 and Government orders

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor of Agril. Statistics.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,000 per month (consolidated) for Master's degree holders and Rs. 45,000 per month for Doctoral degree holders; part-time Rs. 2,000 per contact hour up to Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Agril. Statistics with at least 55% (traditional) / 60% (trimester) / 70% (semester) marks or equivalent grade, plus NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D as per UGC Guidelines 2009/2016. Master's degree holders may be considered if no NET/Ph.D candidates are available.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must attend the interview without any cost to the University. In case of non-availability of reserved category candidates, others will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection by walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment for a period not exceeding 179 days. University may relieve the appointee from duty at any time. Temporary appointment gives no claim to direct appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: College of Forestry, Sirsi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Typed application in the prescribed proforma, two copies, with photographs; All original documents related to qualification; Two sets of self-attested copies of the documents; Caste certificate; Experience certificates; NCC/NSS certificate.
